title: Implant Global Multipliers
doc: Slice toggle and settings for implants-global.json. Implants.ExpandGlobal,
called from Overlays.Load, reads the three multipliers and emits one
ImplantModel rule with no where clause. Off: the rule is not emitted and
every ImplantModel row keeps the game's Cost, InstallTime and
ImplantStress. The rule is part of the overlay load, so it also has no
Three scalars, so a form, not a table.
No where clause, deliberately: the rule reaches all 198 ImplantModel rows
in the game data, including the 20 drone modules (slots 100-107) that no
sheet shows. That reach is accepted (David).
There is no stress floor. A leftover implantStressClampMin key is parsed,
reported at Warning and not applied: in the game data ImplantStress is 1
on 197 rows and 5 on Quantum Rider, so after the stress multiplier
nothing is below 1 for a floor to lift [measured; scripts/implants.py
uiDoc: Turn this off and the three multipliers on this page are not applied.

fields.label: Enable Implant Global Multipliers
fields.doc: On emits the implants-global.json rule; off skips it. Default true.
fields.uiDoc: Turn this off and the three multipliers on this page are not applied.

fields.label: Install cost multiplier
fields.doc: Multiplies ImplantModel.Cost (the clinic price) on every row. In the game data Cost runs 80 to 10200 over the 198 rows [measured, sheets/raw/ImplantModel.csv]. The range is an editor guard rail, not an engine limit: nothing bounds a multiply operand at runtime, and [0.0, 10.0] matches elapse.tiers[].multiplier, the other plain value-scaler in these schemas. 0 zeroes the column; 1 leaves it alone.
fields.uiDoc: Multiplies every implant's clinic price. 1 leaves prices as the game ships them; 0.5 halves them.

fields.label: Install time multiplier
fields.doc: Multiplies ImplantModel.InstallTime on every row. In the game data InstallTime runs 0 to 84 over the 198 rows, 15 distinct values [measured, sheets/raw/ImplantModel.csv]. Range: an editor guard rail, derived as for costMultiply. 1 leaves it alone.
fields.uiDoc: Multiplies the days an implant takes to fit. 1 leaves them as the game ships them.

fields.label: Implant stress multiplier
fields.doc: Multiplies ImplantModel.ImplantStress on every row. In the game data ImplantStress is 1 on 197 rows and 5 on Quantum Rider, so 3 takes them to 3 and 15 [measured, sheets/raw/ImplantModel.csv]. Range: an editor guard rail, derived as for costMultiply. Declared float; check_schema.coerce and check_range accept an integer such as 3.
fields.uiDoc: Multiplies the stress each implant costs to carry. 1 leaves it as the game ships it.
